page_title: AssemblyAI | AI models to transcribe and understand speech

sources.entry: AssemblyAI - (USA) A leading API company for advanced Speech-to-Text, offering highly accurate transcription, summarization, and audio intelligence.

summary.name: AssemblyAI
summary.one_liner: AssemblyAI is a voice AI company offering speech-to-text, text-to-speech and audio understanding models and APIs for developers.
summary.what_it_does: The page describes AssemblyAI's speech models: Universal-3.6 Pro for pre-recorded speech-to-text (32 languages with code-switching), Universal-3.6 Pro Realtime for voice-agent streaming transcription, and AssemblyAI-TTS-1, a text-to-speech model for voice agents covering 6 languages. APIs listed include pre-recorded and realtime speech-to-text, sync transcription, speech understanding (summaries, sentiment, entities), guardrails for PII redaction, text-to-speech, an LLM gateway and a dictation API. Inference can run on managed cloud or self-hosted in a customer's VPC or on-prem. Modes include medical vocabulary, with veterinary and legal modes marked as coming soon. The page cites benchmark rankings and says the models support 99+ languages.
notable: Universal-3.6 Pro and Realtime speech models with native code-switching across 32 languages
Self-hosted deployment option in your own VPC or on-prem
Medical mode for clinical vocabulary; veterinary and legal modes listed as coming soon
Guardrails API for detecting and redacting PII in voice data
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
Veterinary and legal modes are marked as coming soon
Benchmark claims are the company's own presentation
